versions.name: Shotgun Shooting
versions.description: Break clay targets with a modern or muzzleloading shotgun, working on stance, gun mount and swing, and learn gauges, shell parts, cleaning, storage and the three sports built around wing shooting.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
